transformations: All 541909 published transaction lines retained, including missing values and duplicate-looking lines.
Excel dates converted to source calendar timestamps; no timezone assumption.
Line amount is Quantity × UnitPrice using decimal arithmetic. Summary display rounded to GBP pennies; exact source price and calculated decimal amount retained.
Invoice and product tables are derived views of the same UCI export, not independent business systems.
Cancellation candidates match customer, stock code, opposite quantity, price and a non-future timestamp; no original-reference link is asserted.

FX reporting uses the same-or-prior calendar-date ECB observation, retaining its date and rate; this is retrospective reporting, not a point-in-time trading or settlement quote. EUR values are UnitShift calculations, not ECB-published transaction values.
source_limits: Historical records, not live business operations.
No supplier quotes, inventory balances, fulfillment promises, refund authorisations or measured customer savings are present.
No attempt to re-identify the anonymised customers or retailer.
